properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): a reasoning_report page asked at 60,000 reached the client at 63,998 characters and was refused. reflow2 held its own payload under budget, but repeated premise prose fills it, and the hub's id prefixes plus flo2's persona block are added after the budget
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-10-22 on the heat-equation rung's theorem (7f5bd325ad4e8c91:req:thm-uniqueness) through the hub. The refusal was reproduced exactly: "result (63,998 characters) exceeds maximum allowed tokens". The saved reply was analysed field by field (scratchpad heat-trial/rca/).

WHERE THE CHARACTERS GO:
| Part | Characters | Share |
|---|---|---|
| `why` fields | 23,289 | 39% |
| premise-row `why` (each premise's whole explanation re-rendered in each row) | 9,953 | |
| the "cited, unverified … Register the source" sentence (287 × 27) | 7,749 | 12.1% |
| rests_on_unverified id lists | 4,220 | 7.1% |
| the proof's own words (says + warrant) | 8,384 | 13% |

The designer's first attribution (to the repeated citation sentence) was REAL BUT SECONDARY.

REFUTED: that reflow2 overshoots. It held the page to 25 of 26 claims, about 58,174 characters. chars_of counts bytes (reply_budget.rs:108).

ADDED AFTER reflow2's BUDGET:
| Added by | What | Characters |
|---|---|---|
| hub | member prefixes on 287 ids (view.rs:596, prefix_reply → prefix_ids) | +4,879 |
| hub | view_note | +275 |
| flo2 | persona block (engine-api.ts:182) | about +660 |
| | Total | 63,998, the client's figure exactly |

flo2's per-design door passes the reply through unbounded (engine-api.ts:391). That is the same class as the get_skill engine path, which passes no budget (fact:root-cause-get-skill-attaches-every-lesson-unbounded-so-six-skills-outgrow-a-chat-reply-on-reflow2s-design-2026-10-21).

RECURRENCE: req:the-reasoning-read-back-keeps-the-words-of-the-claims-it-returns (FTA friction 2) stopped prose being cut, but did not shrink repeated prose.

FIX:
- reflow2: premise rows carry a short reading and cite the full `why` once;
- the hub budgets for the prefixes it adds (or re-bounds after them);
- flo2: its per-design door honours a reply budget. This goes in the flo2 PR.
